tier_should.rationale: Compelling administrative RD/IV on Colombia’s PEP shows sizable new firm creation and jobs, not mere formalization. Novel composite-threshold RD adds methodological value. Important contribution to immigration, institutions, and entrepreneurship; broad policy relevance and credible identification.

tier_will.rationale: High-quality NBER team, timely topic, strong data and design, and clear results. Fit for top field or marginal general-interest outlet (e.g., AEJ Applied, JPubE, JDE). Some scope limits may preclude top-five general.
